children: Apollo Commercial Real Estate Finance entered into a Termination Agreement with its external manager, ACREFI Management, in connection with the company’s approved dissolution. The agreement provides that the amended and restated management agreement will terminate when the company’s articles of dissolution are accepted and effective in Maryland. The manager waived any termination fee, while the company will pay accrued, unpaid compensation and reimbursable expenses through effectiveness. The move streamlines the wind-down and liquidation process following stockholder approval.
